field.filter: SELECT Person AS P JOIN Organization AS Node ON P.org_id = Node.id JOIN Organization AS Root ON Node.parent_id BELOW Root.id WHERE Root.id = :this->org_id

dashlet.title: UI-ChangeManagementOverview-Next-7-days
